content: PTV EV Truck Route Planner (2024-2025): 450+ digital truck twins, multi-stop (250 stops), per-stop payload/ePTO, weather/traffic/elevation consumption, automatic charging optimization with charge curves, SoC feasibility coloring, battery aging, bulk route upload, toll/cost KPIs, API via PTV Developer. Primarily European vehicles; strong on optimization and vehicle library breadth.
